groups.problem: The save callback overwrites the server-resolved category with the blank submitted category selection.
groups.rationale: All three describe the same callback replacing the saved uncategorized relationship with findById(null), leaving the displayed category incorrect.

groups.problem: The migration dereferences an empty embed_category query result before reaching its fallback.
groups.rationale: Each reports the unchecked first row of the same category query. S1 mentions handling missing fallback settings only as part of its proposed fix.

groups.problem: The migration inserts legacy host URLs without the normalization required by the new hostname lookup.
groups.rationale: All three identify the same direct SQL insertion bypassing scheme and path removal, causing migrated hosts to stop matching.

groups.problem: Port-qualified stored hosts cannot match lookup values extracted with URI.host.
groups.rationale: Both describe the same mismatch between accepted host values containing ports and the port-free lookup value.

problems: The initial embed_category query can return no rows and crash before the fallback.
The uncategorized fallback query also dereferences a missing stored setting row.
uncoveredProblems: The uncategorized fallback query crashes when its setting row is absent.
